# the contributor audit: exact contact-cell repair and projective interfaces

## Contact-constrained cell repair

Source: `candidate e6ba532e542af929`.
Independent audit: `historical context (not an accepted premise)`.


The allowed coupling class is compact and convex because both Jensen
gaps are nonnegative continuous functions on the compact pair support.
Joint canonical output labels for the active L plane and roof plane
partition the actual optimizer. Zero gaps force both endpoint supports
into the corresponding closed convex cells. Any replacement coupling
of those restricted marginals therefore remains globally admissible,
including on ties and on the closures of the restricted supports.

Consequently each existing restriction is an unrestricted strong-surplus
optimizer. The density argument applies to that restriction itself.
Its output remains in its original canonical part, so summing the
dominations over disjoint output parts uses one target capacity. This
does not independently rebuild couplings and then presume disjointness.

The finite-intersection argument is correctly run after the individual
optimizations and inside the closed contact class. The final marked
martingale also preserves L contact because its two midpoint laws have
equal L integrals. No extra number-of-cells factor occurs.

The exact dissipation formula follows from affine barycenter preservation
for the plane active at each source. It is nonnegative and vanishes
precisely at rowwise contact. The diagnostic square stress has strictly
positive dissipation; its arithmetic and the distinction between that
stress and an actual selected logarithmic minimum are correct. Inverse-
volume parameter rows cannot be identified with surface rows.

## Aligned homothetic stratum

Source: `candidate 3811d52ee1189750`.

hypotheses.

One affine energy-root supergradient at a relative-interior marked point
agrees with the affine height on the entire stratum. Its stated continuous
coefficient gives the exact common chart after the d/(d+1) adjustment;
the added positive affine height supplies the claimed positivity floor.
The same relative-interior argument makes one support majorant touch all
stratum fibers. Scaling each source field by ell_i^(-(d+1)) gives the
identical field h_D/L^d. The own cost is d E_D/ell_i, as stated, and is
not a proxy for the original fiber volume.

The common support-contact mask is midpoint closed by its affine height
and convex containment. This validates using weighted repair on the mask,
while all other contacted fibers remain real costs requiring payment.

## Genuine source-normalizer obstruction

Source: `candidate 513a098b26545097`.

plus/minus 8/13 and therefore the claimed unique projective normalizers.
On the forced midpoint interval the available maximum-field capacity is
one third of the input mass. The extension-positivity inequalities have
the correct signs and give factor at least 33/20; retaining the stated
canonical floor gives at least 1503/676>2. The conclusions are restricted
to the fixed flat contact slopes and specified source points. Neither
critical-source selection nor all support-slope choices are refuted.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
